title: Justin Trudeau named distinguished fellow at Oxford's Blavatnik School of Government
summary: Former prime minister Justin Trudeau has joined England's Oxford University in a new role.

image.caption: Former prime minister Justin Trudeau is shown on Sept. 11 at the Toronto International Film Festival, where he launched a new production company with Katie Telford, his ex-chief of staff. (Laura Proctor/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: Former prime minister Justin Trudeau has joined England's Oxford University in a new role.
Former prime minister will become member of school's World Leaders Circle
Trudeau, 54, joined the Blavatnik School of Government as a distinguished fellow and member of the World Leaders Circle, the school said in a news release on Friday.

The release says the former Liberal leader joins an international network of former heads of government, including former New Zealand prime minister Jacinda Ardern and former British prime minister Rishi Sunak.
From 2015 to 2025, Trudeau served as Canada's prime minister before stepping down.
The Blavatnik School, founded in 2010, says it is focused on public policy education and inspiring students to improve the "quality of government and public policy-making worldwide."

blocks.text: Trudeau says in the news release that he is looking forward to "contributing his experience" and working with other leaders to "consider how governments can respond to change and build a more hopeful, inclusive and prosperous future for everyone."
"In the decade that I was prime minister, the world went through profound change both geopolitically and technologically, which fundamentally reshaped our world," Trudeau said.
Ngaire Woods, dean of the Blavatnik School, said Trudeau brings "a wealth of experience, forged through a decade of public service" that will be beneficial to students.
"Our students are the public leaders of tomorrow, and the opportunity to learn directly from those who have navigated the complexities of government ... is invaluable," Woods said in the release.
Trudeau is expected to visit the school later this month.

items: Justin Trudeau launches new film and TV production company

blocks.text: Since stepping back from politics following his resignation as federal Liberal leader and prime minister last year, Trudeau has flitted in and out of the public eye, delivering speeches around the world and popping up at events with his popstar girlfriend Katy Perry.

Last month, Trudeau announced that he was venturing into the entertainment world with the launch of a new media and entertainment production company called Hope & Hard Work, a joint project with Katie Telford, his longtime chief of staff.
